description: This file defines the ActivationLifetime class, which manages the lifecycle and deactivation blocking for grain activation instances within Orleans. It implements lifecycle observation, cancellation tokens, and lock management for deactivation control.

classes.name: ActivationLifetime
classes.description: Manages activation lifecycle, including deactivation blocking and cancellation handling.

classes.name: BlockDeactivationDisposable
classes.description: Disposable class used to block deactivation by incrementing and decrementing the lock count.

methods.name: ActivationLifetime
methods.description: Constructor that subscribes to lifecycle stages.

methods.name: OnDeactivating
methods.description: Property exposing the cancellation token for deactivation.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Method called on activation start, currently a no-op.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles deactivation, cancels ongoing deactivation, and waits for locks to release.

methods.name: OnStopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous wait for deactivation locks to clear within a timeout.

methods.name: BlockDeactivation
methods.description: Returns a disposable that blocks deactivation when disposed.
